done_when: The every-platform run has no macOS groups, Linux and Windows keep their groups and limits, and the CI budget tests match

known.title: Follow-up: Align documented release checks with the reduced matrix

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 1, Harm 2
Removing the macOS groups makes the documented release prerequisite impossible to satisfy: docs/guide.md:379–380 instructs maintainers to dispatch this workflow and confirm Linux, Mac and Windows are green before tagging. README.md:261–262 likewise requires checking all three platforms. Update both instructions to match Linux and Windows so maintainers can complete the documented checks.
findings.title: Follow-up: Align documented release checks with the reduced matrix

why: Forge's every-platform run spends nine macOS groups that time out on slow runners and have found no macOS-only product bug; Linux and Windows catch the platform bugs, and every close already runs its tests on a Mac
